title: Executive Director-System Operational Excellence
text:
**Executive Director-System Operational Excellence**
====================================================

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Overview**

*Our leaders shape strategic initiatives, develop passionate teams, and work to improve health outcomes. They advance our mission and exemplify excellence, compassion, teamwork and purpose in all that they do****.*** Indiana University Health is seeking individuals who embody these values to join our System Services leadership team in the role of Executive Director, System Operational Excellence.

The **Executive Director, System Operational Excellence** provides enterprise leadership for IU Health’s operational excellence strategy, management system, and continuous improvement efforts. This highly visible leader will partner with executive and operational leaders across the organization to advance performance improvement initiatives that strengthen quality, safety, workforce engagement, service, and operational outcomes. Leading a high-performing team, the Executive Director will play a key role in aligning improvement efforts with organizational priorities and driving measurable, system-wide impact.

This leader will be responsible for advancing and maturing IU Health’s Lean management system, developing leaders’ problem-solving capabilities, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement across a complex, matrixed healthcare environment. This is a unique opportunity to build upon a strong operational excellence foundation and help shape the future of performance improvement at IU Health by developing leaders, strengthening organizational capabilities, and accelerating strategic priorities across the enterprise.

**Key Relationships**

Reports to: Vice President – Operational Excellence

**Candidate Qualifications**

Candidates for the position will be evaluated according to the following criteria and competencies.

* Bachelor's Degree is required. Master's Degree is preferred.
* Requires 10 plus years of relevant experience.
* Requires 4 years of people leader experience.
* Requires a minimum of 5 years of experience within a complex healthcare system.
* Lean Six Sigma Black Belt certification is required. Master Black Belt is preferred.
* Must have a demonstrated record of sustaining improvements after implementation.
* Requires experience developing and delivering Lean/DMAIC training programs.
* Requires experience helping establish Operational Excellence strategy, priorities, and multi-year roadmaps.
* Requires a proven ability to influence leaders in a large matrixed organization.
* Requires advanced knowledge of Lean tools, including Value Stream Mapping, Daily Management Systems, Standard Work, Visual Management, 5S, Flow/Pull Systems, and Poka-Yoke (Mistake Proofing).
* Requires strong DMAIC project leadership with the ability to lead through all phases.
* Requires the ability to facilitate large groups and drive consensus among stakeholders.
* Requires the ability to teach improvement methodology from frontline staff through executive leadership.
* Requires strong coaching, mentoring, and adult learning skills.
* Requires portfolio management and project prioritization expertise.
* Requires the ability to connect improvement work directly to organizational strategy and performance outcomes.
* Additional Lean certification (Shingo, LEI, AME, etc.) is preferred.
 

Indiana University Health is unlike any other healthcare system and we're looking for team members who share the things that matter most to us. IU Health leaders play a crucial role in advancing the mission of our organization and inspiring teams to make a meaningful difference in the lives of patients. As one of Indiana’s largest employers and the most comprehensive medical system in the state, our vision is ***to lead the transformation of healthcare through quality, innovation and education, and make Indiana one*** ***of the nation’s healthiest states.***

IU Health is the largest health system in Indiana with nearly 40,000 team members, 15 hospitals and $8.64 billion in operating revenue. The system’s programs in cancer, cardiovascular, neuroscience, orthopedics, pediatrics and transplants have received national recognition for quality patient care. IU Health, in partnership with the Indiana University School of Medicine, bring together highly skilled physicians, researchers, and educators into close collaboration to provide world-class care for children and adults and improve the health of patients and communities across Indiana.

***Indiana University Health is dedicated to a fair hiring process and is committed to equal opportunity and nondiscrimination for all individuals, regardless of age, color, disability, ethnicity, marital status, national origin, race, religion, gender identity, expression, sexual orientation, or veteran status.***

We are an equal opportunity employer. IU Health does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, national origin, gender identity and/or expression, marital status or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

Indiana University Health is Indiana’s most comprehensive health system, with 15 hospitals and nearly 40,000 team members serving Hoosiers across the state. Our partnership with the Indiana University School of Medicine gives our team members access to the very latest science and the very best training, advancing care for all. We’re looking for team members who share the things that matter most to us. People who are inspired by challenging and meaningful work for the good of every patient. People who are compassionate and serve with a purpose. People who aspire to excellence every day. People who are always ready to apply themselves.
